However, the alignment is not perfect (5.0) because the complex ventral anatomy is muddled, preventing full verification of limb count and attachment symmetry.

This is corroborated by low-confidence pose keypoints in the hind limbs and a fragmented topology mask. Minor texture anomalies in the background netting further reduce the artifact score. The image is not catastrophic (like Ref 1) but has clear generative flaws in occlusion handling.
